title: MAS-Bai: Linguistically Informed Adaptive Multi-Agent Translation for Bowen-Script Bai
abstract: arXiv:2610.23205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain unreliable for extremely low-resource languages whose writing systems conflict with high-resource pretraining priors. We study Bai-Chinese translation in the Bowen script, where Chinese characters are frequently borrowed phonetically rather than semantically, causing severe literal-translation hallucinations. We propose MAS-Bai, a linguistically informed adaptive multi-agent framework for Bowen-script Bai-Chinese translation. MAS-Bai routes each input through either a lightweight retrieval-translation path or a deeper philological path with etymological and syntactic agents, and uses cycle-consistency with a lightweight reverse translator as an inference-time reliability signal. We construct a 6,536-sentence Bai-Chinese corpus and evaluate on a 1,536-sentence test set. MAS-Bai achieves 16.23 BLEU and 62.15 COMET, improving over Standard RAG by 8.11 BLEU and 6.85 COMET. translated_title: MAS-Bai：面向白文白语的语言学知识驱动的自适应多智能体翻译
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）对于书写系统与高资源预训练先验相冲突的极低资源语言仍然不可靠。我们研究了白文书写系统下的白语-汉语翻译问题，其中汉字经常被语音借用而非语义借用，导致严重的直译幻觉。我们提出了MAS-Bai，一个面向白文白语-汉语翻译的语言学知识驱动的自适应多智能体框架。MAS-Bai将每个输入路由到轻量级的检索-翻译路径，或包含词源智能体与句法智能体的更深层文献学路径，并利用轻量级反向翻译器的循环一致性作为推理时的可靠性信号。我们构建了一个包含6,536个句子的白语-汉语语料库，并在1,536个句子的测试集上进行评估。MAS-Bai取得了16.23 BLEU和62.15 COMET的成绩，相比标准RAG提升了8.11 BLEU和6.85 COMET。前向LoRA、专家消融……（摘要截断）
tldr: MAS-Bai提出了一种融合语言学知识的自适应多智能体翻译框架，通过在轻量级检索-翻译路径与包含词源、句法智能体的文献学路径之间动态路由，并结合循环一致性可靠性信号，显著提升了白文白语-汉语的翻译质量并缓解了直译幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: MAS-Bai is a linguistically informed adaptive multi-agent framework that routes each input between a lightweight retrieval-translation path and a deeper philological path with etymological and syntactic agents, using cycle-consistency as an inference-time reliability signal to substantially improve Bowen-script Bai-Chinese translation and mitigate literal-translation hallucinations.
